page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-360 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the 64-bit Arm (arm64) architecture. Driven by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family, the instance provides 90 dedicated physical cores operating at a base clock speed of 3.6 GHz without simultaneous multithreading (1 thread per core), yielding 90 vCPUs. System memory totals 360.0 GB, maintaining a consistent allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent data retention and operating system installations. Graphical acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. Architectural considerations center on the AmpereOne-M design, where dedicated single-threaded cores eliminate noisy-neighbor resource contention typically associated with simultaneous multithreading. However, compatibility is bound to the arm64 instruction set, meaning workloads relying on x86-specific instruction sets cannot execute without recompilation or emulation.

With its 1:4 core-to-memory profile and high dedicated core count, VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-360 offers efficient resource density for horizontal compute scaling and highly threaded software deployments. The balance of 90 full physical cores paired with 360 GB of memory aligns well with enterprise containerized microservices, large-scale CI/CD build environments, batch data processing, distributed caching tiers, and multi-threaded web serving workloads optimized for Arm platforms.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-360 is an Arm-based cloud instance powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor architecture. The configuration is equipped with 90 dedicated physical cores running at 3.6 GHz, featuring a single-thread-per-core design that provides 90 vCPUs without hyperthreading overhead. It incorporates 360.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local NVMe or SSD storage is bundled with the instance, and no discrete GPUs are included, directing persistent data storage requirements to remote cloud storage. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided. The lack of hardware multithreading guarantees dedicated compute cycles per vCPU, reducing virtualization contention across parallelized tasks. This balance of high dedicated core density and memory makes VM.Standard.A4.Flex.45-360 suited for scale-out container clusters, multi-threaded application servers, CI/CD compilation pipelines, batch processing, and distributed Arm-native workloads.
